source_baseline: DDD-BDM-010 + 2026-09-14 G1 revalidation + ADR-019 + ADR-020 + ADR-021

bounded_contexts.name: Business Connectivity
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Business Process meaning/responsibility, application-semantic Connectivity Need, business attribution and justification reconciliation.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Governance
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Access Request history, source/destination approval obligations, side decisions, bilateral authorization grant, withdrawal/revocation and governance provenance.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Authoritative current Policy Rule truth and effective authorized-policy projection.

bounded_contexts.name: Authority Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Effective scoped actor/action authority and role/group/scope assignment semantics.

bounded_contexts.name: Resource Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Resource/Endpoint identity, Resource Scope Affiliation and current/historical corporate-visible address realization.

bounded_contexts.name: Application Communication Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Application/Component/ComponentDeployment/Interaction identities and immutable interaction traffic contracts.

bounded_contexts.name: Network Enforcement Placement
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Candidate enforcement-location relevance plus applicable policy/ACL locators.

bounded_contexts.name: Technical Access Evidence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical evidence with provenance/time/source scope and no authorization/current-policy claim.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy Realization
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Source-neutral required-vs-configured effective-policy assessment, semantic reconciliation, vendor-neutral change design and proposed-result semantic verification.

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Requirements
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; Need semantics moved to Business Connectivity

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Decision
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; bilateral consent/grant/revocation semantics moved to Access Governance

derived_compositions.name: Required Policy Materialization
derived_compositions.responsibility: Derive normalized required technical predicates and target-specific required effective policy from Access Policy, ACC, Resource Catalogue and NEP published contracts; unresolved inputs remain explicit.

integration_capabilities.name: Provider Policy Interpretation
integration_capabilities.responsibility: Translate provider-native configured policy into comparable ConfiguredEffectivePolicySnapshot with explicit scope, completeness, provenance and unsupported-semantics outcome.

integration_capabilities.name: Provider Policy Rendering
integration_capabilities.responsibility: Translate APR-verified vendor-neutral intent into a semantically equivalent TargetPolicyArtifact or fail closed when unsupported.

invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Business Need does not authorize access.
Grant requires source-side and destination-side consent; either authorized side may withdraw current consent.
Authority Management owns effective action authority; consumers own decisions made using that authority.
Required Policy Materialization is derived composition; unresolved is not empty required policy or APR drift.
Technical evidence is not authorization and is not automatically current/complete configured policy.
Provider interpretation/rendering are adapter/integration capabilities, not peer Bounded Contexts.
APR core remains provider-neutral and compares source-neutral effective policy semantics.
Rendering must preserve verified semantics and fail closed when equivalence cannot be established.
NEO owns execution lifecycle, not policy reinterpretation.
Technical realization changes do not redefine semantic authorization identity.
open_strategic_questions: Responsibility-scope change consequences for existing authorization.
Exact Process organizational-responsibility contract with external enterprise structure.
